info.title: Castor EDC Universal API
info.description: Access Castor EDC studies, users, participants, records, forms, and clinical data through the official Castor EDC API.

post.description: Creates a survey package instance in Castor EDC.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

surveyPackageId.description: The survey package UUID to instantiate.

participantId.description: Participant UUID to receive the survey package instance.

ccrPatientId.description: CCR patient identifier to receive the survey package instance.

emailAddress.description: Optional email address to send the invitation to.

packageInvitationSubject.description: Optional subject for the invitation email.

packageInvitation.description: Optional invitation email body; include {url} if you want Castor to send it from this request.

availableFrom.description: UTC datetime when the survey package instance becomes available or is scheduled to send.

autoLockOnFinish.description: Lock the survey package instance automatically when the respondent finishes.

parentType.description: Parent type: 0 none, 1 visit, 2 repeating data instance.

parentId.description: Optional UUID of the parent visit or repeating data instance.
